name: Chromastone
abilities: Energy absorption (lasers, electricity, manna, EM radiation) and conversion into rainbow-coloured energy beams
Supercharged blasts after absorbing energy (subdued the Mapmaker, damaged Dagon)
Very dense crystal body (high durability; Xenocite immune)
Space survivability, radiation and heat resistance
Crystal entrapment via beams; light and gamma-ray generation
weaknesses: Absorption limit - overloaded and disintegrated trying to absorb the Sorcerer's Engine's manna
Cannot absorb some energies (Contumelia field, Annihilarrgh)
Can be shattered by sufficient brute force - an empowered Vilgax broke him apart (Vengeance of Vilgax: Part 2)
Can be controlled by Vladat Corrupturas
summary: A one-eyed living crystal that drinks up almost any energy attack and fires it back as rainbow beams; briefly destroyed and reborn via Diamondhead in Alien Force.
traits: Shattered by Vilgax and later restored by Sugilite
notableFeats: Absorbed and returned the Mapmaker's blast (Be-Knighted)
Escaped the Omnitrix and fought Murk Upchuck; later shattered by Vilgax (Vengeance of Vilgax: Part 2)
Damaged Dagon after Gwen fed him manna (The Ultimate Enemy: Part 2)
Pierced the Contumelia's field with a Skurd-made Alien X sword to retrieve the Annihilarrgh (A New Dawn)

appearances.designNotes: Indigo crystal humanoid with magenta face/hands, six back shards, two chest shards and a horn shard, single green eye; recalibrated Omnitrix symbol on chest.
Same design as Alien Force with the Ultimatrix symbol on chest. Heroes United cameo had green teeth.

OV1 (Trouble Helix only): near-identical to UAF with much longer back/head crystals, Omnitrix on chest. OV2 (A New Dawn): extra shards on shoulders, forearms, knees and head sides, chest shards removed, longer neck, magenta mouth-guard chin, five-fingered crystal hands, green jumpsuit with white-striped bands; Omnitrix on right pectoral. OV2 chosen as it is the later design and had the most screen time.

image.label: OV2
image.notes: infobox OV2 render; OV1 alternate is 'Chromastone OV1.png'

scoring.rationale: Energy absorption/redirection (8) makes him the answer to lasers, manna and lightning, and supercharged blasts hurt Dagon; dense crystal body tanks vehicle impacts and radiation. Physically only mid-tier, and over-absorption disintegrated him while Vilgax shattered him outright.

notes: Homeworld: wiki says Petropia; MorOtesi was retconned into a legend by The Secret of Chromastone.
OV appearances are only Trouble Helix (OV1, off-screen activation) and A New Dawn (OV2, x2).
Also used by a Plant Clone Ben (The Big Story).
AF S1 (wiki) = ben-15-af, AF S2 = ben-16-af.
